title: Arizer ArGo 6 Pack Screens
description: Upgrade your Arizer ArGo experience with the Arizer ArGo 6 Pack Screens. Designed exclusively for the ArGo Vaporizer, this pack includes 6 high-quality stainless steel filter screens for the Glass Aroma Tubes. These ArGo screens help maintain a clean vapor path, ensuring efficient filtration. While the Arizer ArGo screens offer convenience, they can slightly impact vapor smoothness. For the purest flavour, consider using the built-in glass screen with coarsely ground botanicals. This 6 pack of ArGo stainless steel filter screens is a must-have accessory for those seeking to optimize their vaping experience with added filtration.
